order: One summary; for each mode complete collisions and negative-bound count; each declared palette condition, huge bound count, last-collision multiplicity profile, three numeric selects with exact inverse ranks for every nonempty palette; two inclusive windows.
bounds: Huge prefix threshold 10^40. Windows [10^30,10^30+10^6] and [0,last saved collision]. No verification interval scan.
banking: Bank each request before dispatch; response and full current caches/work immediately afterward. No constructor or pair-intersection replay. On failure retain actual error/pending request and stop.
scope: All prefix counts are exact for the selected finite offset union only. Numeric order of values, zero-based ranks, inclusive windows; empty palette is counted but never selected.
